progression.narrative: The performance opens on A#3 and dwells most on D in Suz-o Godaz. The line peaks at D5 (590.4 Hz) at 0:30.4. It closes on D5, not the tonic (D4 → C#4 → D4 → C#4 → D5 → D5).
